# Skytech Green

> Skytech Green is a brand of SKYTECH HAVACILIK VE TEKNOLOJİ SANAYİ TİCARET ANONİM ŞİRKETİ, registered on 7 May 2024 in Türkiye. The brand's origin story refers to the 2021 Mediterranean forest fires, not the company registration date.

## Service and products

Customers purchase a drone seed-release service for a selected Project Site. This is a service purchase, not a donation or a shipment of seeds to the customer's address. Consult the site and ordering pages for the current product, availability, price and schedule.

Two product types are distinct:
- Seaweed-extract coated seed: a seed coated with a mixture containing seaweed extract.
- Seed ball: a seed enclosed in a ball made with clay and a nutrient mixture.

Release season is November–March. Monitoring and reporting are generally scheduled for April–September; site-specific commitments are provided before ordering. The service includes release work, a Certificate of Participation after release and subsequent monitoring records. Corporate customers receive an Activity Report describing the work. A participation certificate is not a carbon credit.

Germination and growth depend on natural and site conditions. No germination percentage, tree count, lifespan, carbon offset or carbon-neutrality outcome is guaranteed. Illustrative images and example dashboard data are not evidence of completed work.

## Public sources

- [Project Sites](https://skytechgreen.com/sahalar): locations, product types, current phases and published work records.
- [Coated Seeds](https://skytechgreen.com/kaplamali-tohum): definition, distinction from seed balls and service scope.
- [Seed Balls](https://skytechgreen.com/tohum-topu): the separate seed-ball method.
- [Seed Species](https://skytechgreen.com/tohumlarimiz): species information; the site plan determines selection.
- [Drone Technology](https://skytechgreen.com/dron-teknolojisi): planned release operations.
- [Activity Report](https://skytechgreen.com/karbon-programi): report contents and limitations.
- [Corporate Participation](https://skytechgreen.com/kurumsal-cozumler): corporate participation and documentation.
- [Own Land](https://skytechgreen.com/kendi-arazim): application for land assessment.
- [About](https://skytechgreen.com/hakkimizda): brand and company background.
- [Contact](https://skytechgreen.com/iletisim): current company identity and contact details.

Public information supports Turkish, English (/en) and Russian (/ru). Legal document bodies are published in Turkish; localized navigation does not constitute a translation.

## Evidence and current state

Use a site's dated release records and monitoring reports for claims about completed work. News about a fire gives background on the location, not proof of completed Skytech work. Do not infer a planted tree from a released seed or a verified outcome from a plan or illustration.

Ordering availability can change. This file does not assert that payment is enabled or disabled. Refer to the current public ordering information; private account pages and APIs are not public sources.
